Clean background-free theme for ggexon plots

Source: R/theme-ggexon.R
theme_ggexon_clean.Rd

theme_ggexon_clean() keeps the minimal-theme grids, axes, text, and legend styling while removing panel outlines and facet-strip background rectangles. It is the named public shortcut for ggexon's background-free theme contract.

Usage

theme_ggexon_clean(base_size = 8, base_family = "")

Arguments

base_size

Base font size passed to ggplot2::theme_minimal().

base_family

Base font family passed to ggplot2::theme_minimal().

Value

A ggplot2 theme object.

See also

theme_ggexon_base(), theme_ggexon_track(), theme_ggexon_side_strips()
